texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} did the spring sowing side by side, and talked about what this year's crop would be.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued, in a friendly way, about how far apart the rows should be while they sowed.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} which of last year's crops had done best, and they agreed to sow more of it.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} stopped sowing for a moment to see how much of the field was done, and agreed it was a good start.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sowed side by side, and talked about the seasons the old ones had sown through before them.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sowed the field together, a row each, and {A_nameDef} kept count of the rows.
[industrial] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} went over the seed stock while they sowed, and worked out what would last until the harvest.
[spacer] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sowed together and talked about which of the crops would do best on this world.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat out together on a warm summer evening and talked until it got dark.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} stayed outside after the day's work in the warm air, and neither of them wanted to go in.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about the best summer {A_pronoun} could remember, and {B_nameDef} said this one was going well too.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} watched the light go out of the sky, talking about nothing much.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat out in the warm dusk listening to the insects, and talked about the summers of their childhood.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat out in the long summer evening and talked until the first stars came out.
[industrial] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} stayed out in the summer evening, glad of the cooler air after the heat of the day.
[spacer] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat out in the summer evening and talked about the other worlds they had seen.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef}, who have both been here a long time, spent a winter evening talking about how the colony looked when they first came.
{A_nameDef} reminded {B_nameDef} of the colony's first winter, and they went through who had been here then and who had come since.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} spent a winter evening remembering the colony's early days, and laughed about how little they had known then.
{A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} if {B_pronoun} remembered the first walls going up, and {B_nameDef} remembered more of it than {A_nameDef} did.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} remembered the first shelters, when everyone slept round one fire, and how cold that winter had been.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about the colony's first winter, when there was hardly a roof over anyone's head, and how they had managed.
[industrial] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} remembered the first winter, before most of what stands here now was built, and how they had kept warm.
[spacer] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about how much of their old gear had broken in the first winter, and what they had made do with since.
{B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {B_pronoun} had learned to do it where {B_pronoun} came from while they were {WORK}, and {A_nameDef} tried it that way.
{B_nameDef}, new as {B_pronoun} was, showed {A_nameDef} a quicker way while they were {WORK}, and {A_nameDef} took it up.
While they were {WORK}, {A_nameDef} watched {B_nameDef} do it differently and asked where {B_pronoun} had learned that.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were {WORK} together, and {A_nameDef} found that {B_nameDef} knew a trick or two that nobody here did.
[tribal] {B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how it was done in {B_possessive} old band while they were {WORK}, and {A_nameDef} said {A_pronoun} would try it.
[medieval] {B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how they did it in the town {B_pronoun} came from while they were {WORK}, and {A_nameDef} admitted it was better.
[industrial] While they were {WORK}, {B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} a method from {B_possessive} old workplace, and {A_nameDef} said {A_pronoun} would use it.
[spacer] While they were {WORK}, {B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how it was done where {B_pronoun} served before, and {A_nameDef} was impressed.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were playing at the {THING}, and {A_nameDef} said {B_nameDef} had cheated, and {B_nameDef} said {A_nameDef} had.
A game at the {THING} between {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} ended with both of them claiming they had won.
{A_nameDef} lost to {B_nameDef} at the {THING} and said it only happened because {B_nameDef} kept talking.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued so long over one turn at the {THING} that they never finished the game.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} said {B_nameDef}'s last turn at the {THING} did not count, and they argued about it until both walked off.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} swore that {B_nameDef} had cheated at the {THING}, and {B_nameDef} swore that {A_nameDef} was a poor loser.
[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} kept score at the {THING} and could not agree on what the score was.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were still annoyed with each other when they sat down to eat, and by the end of the meal they had made up.
{A_nameDef} passed {B_nameDef} a dish without being asked, and after that the two of them talked over the meal as if nothing had happened.
{A_nameDef} said sorry to {B_nameDef} over the meal, plainly, and {B_nameDef} said sorry too.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} ended up eating near each other, still sore, and talked it through before they had finished.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} shared {A_possessive} food with {B_nameDef}, the way {A_possessive} people end a quarrel, and {B_nameDef} took it.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} offered {B_nameDef} bread at the meal and said the quarrel was over, and {B_nameDef} agreed it was.
[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} sat down across from {B_nameDef} with {A_possessive} meal and said the colony was too small for a grudge, and {B_nameDef} agreed.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: a child's question about the dead

texts.li: {B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} where {X_nameDef} had gone, and {A_nameDef} told {B_objective} the truth as gently as {A_pronoun} could.
{B_nameDef} wanted to know if {X_nameDef} had been afraid, and {A_nameDef} sat down with {B_objective} and answered every question.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} a story about {X_nameDef} that {B_nameDef} had never heard, and {B_nameDef} asked for another one.
After {X_nameDef} died, {B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether everyone dies, and {A_nameDef} said yes, but most people not for a very long time.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} that {X_nameDef} had gone to the ancestors, and that {A_possessive} people keep the names of the dead so they are not forgotten.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} that {X_nameDef} would be remembered in the colony's prayers, as the dead always were where {A_pronoun} grew up.
[industrial] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} that {X_nameDef} was not in pain any more, and promised to tell {B_objective} more about {X_objective} whenever {B_pronoun} asked.
[spacer] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} what {X_nameDef} had done before coming here, the parts {B_nameDef} was old enough to hear.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: answered a child's questions about the dead

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: old and small hands

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were {WORK} side by side, {A_nameDef} slow and careful and {B_nameDef} quick, and between them the work got done.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} how to do it properly while they were {WORK}, and then let {B_objective} do the rest.
{B_nameDef} kept asking {A_nameDef} questions while they were {WORK}, and {A_nameDef} answered every one without stopping.
{A_nameDef} let {B_nameDef} set the pace while they were {WORK}, and was the first to need a rest.
[tribal] {A_nameDef} taught {B_nameDef} a work song {A_possessive} people sing while they were {WORK}, and {B_nameDef} knew the words by the end.
[medieval] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} how it was done when {A_pronoun} was a child, while they were {WORK} together.
[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} how it was done before machines took over the hard part, while they were {WORK} together.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: worked side by side, one old and one small
